title: 第1章 桃花侠大战菊花怪-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》
content:
第(1/3)页

    2008年3月。

    香江某片场，《桃与菊》剧组。

    伴随着现场导演的喊声，今天的拍摄任务结束，全组收工。

    魏沐左手拿着由塑料制成的桃花瓣，右手握着一把按一下会发光的玩具剑，正要离开。

    他的角色是桃花侠，也是这部戏的男主角。

    “喂，靓仔，你要回宾馆嘛？”

    听到动静，他停住了脚步，转身看去，是女主角菊花怪。

    只见她身穿不知道哪个朝代的戏服，化了一个浓妆，头上梳着毛利兰同款“尖角”发型。

    魏沐望着她，努力压抑住想要吐槽她发型的冲动，笑着回答：“是啊。”

    听到这番话，菊花怪笑着走向前，搂住他的胳膊，胸前的一抹白腻紧贴在对方身上，轻声细语道：“一起走，我也要回宾馆。”

    魏沐本想拒绝，但感受到柔软的触感，想了想还是没有开口。

    两人一同回到宾馆后，菊花怪还想邀请他进去喝杯茶，魏沐笑着婉拒。

    “砰”的一声，门被关上。

    因为被拒绝，连带着关门的声音也大了不少。

    “什么人啊，白给你睡都不愿意？是不是傻？”

    菊花怪被拒绝以后低声骂了一句。

    不过一想到未来几天拍的戏，她嘴角微微翘起，冷哼一声。

    “过几天有你难受的，到时候求我都没门！！”

    魏沐自然没有听到门外的动静，他收起营业性微笑，心中腹诽：“想睡我？没门！”

    大家都是成年人了，喝杯茶当然不是简单的喝茶。

    就像新茶到货，也不是指的茶叶。

    他不是想当柳下惠坐怀不乱，而是刚来这地方还有些不熟悉，不好贸然出鸡。

    没错，他穿越了。

    作为一名唯物主义者，他本来是不相信有穿越这回事，但是眼前的情况让他不得不相信。

    从口袋里掏出门卡，进了门。

    脱掉衣服，来到浴室洗了个澡。

    十分钟后，从热气腾腾的浴室中走了出来。

    白色浴巾裹住他结实的下半身。

    水珠在他完美雕塑的胸肌上闪烁着微光，仿佛珍珠滑过光滑的大理石。

    魏沐来到镜子前再次欣赏起来。

    “比我前世还帅！！”

    只见镜中的男人个子很高，有183（无内增高等一系列魔法加成）。

    身形颀长挺拔，生的很好看，戴上眼镜时，气质斯文优雅，给人一种即便是渣男也要义无反顾扑上去的感觉。

    眼下不戴眼镜，更显得清冷矜贵。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

March 2008.

A certain studio in Xiangjiang, the crew of "Peach and Chrysanthemum".

With the shout of the on-site director, today’s shooting task is over and the whole team has called it a day.

Wei Mu held a peach petal made of plastic in his left hand and a toy sword that would light up when pressed in his right hand, and was about to leave.

His role is Peach Blossom Man, and he is also the male protagonist of this drama.

"Hey, pretty boy, do you want to go back to the hotel?"

Hearing the noise, he stopped and turned around to see that it was the heroine Chrysanthemum Monster.

I saw her wearing a costume from an unknown dynasty, heavy makeup, and the same "pointed-angle" hairstyle as Mao Lilan.

Wei Mu looked at her, trying hard to suppress the urge to complain about her hairstyle, and replied with a smile: "Yes."

Hearing these words, Ju Hua walked forward with a strange smile, hugged his arm, and pressed the white hair on his chest against the other person's body, and whispered softly: "Let's go together, I want to go back to the hotel too."

Wei Mu wanted to refuse, but after feeling the soft touch, he thought about it and still did not speak.

After the two returned to the hotel together, the chrysanthemum monster wanted to invite him in for a cup of tea, but Wei Mu declined with a smile.

With a "bang" sound, the door was closed.

Because he was rejected, the sound of the door closing became much louder.

"Who are you, willing to sleep with you for free? Are you stupid?"

After being rejected, the chrysanthemum monster cursed in a low voice.

But when she thought about the filming in the next few days, the corners of her mouth curled up slightly and she snorted coldly.

“You will feel uncomfortable in a few days, and you won’t even be able to ask me for help!!”

Wei Mu naturally did not hear the movement outside the door. He put away his business smile and cursed in his heart: "Want to sleep with me? No way!"

We are all adults, so drinking a cup of tea is certainly not just drinking tea.

"It's like when new tea arrives, it doesn't mean tea leaves.

He didn’t want to be Liu Xiahui’s wife, but he just came to this place and was a little unfamiliar with it, so it was hard to rush out.

That’s right, he traveled through time.

As a materialist, he originally didn’t believe in time travel, but the situation in front of him forced him to believe it.

He took out the key card from his pocket and entered the door.

I took off my clothes and went to the bathroom to take a shower.

Ten minutes later, I walked out of the steaming bathroom.

A white bath towel wrapped around his strong lower body.

The water droplets shimmered on his perfectly sculpted chest muscles, like pearls sliding across smooth marble.

Wei Mu came to the mirror and admired it again.

“More handsome than my previous life!!”

I saw that the man in the mirror was very tall, 183cm tall (without a series of magic bonuses such as inner height increase).

He has a tall and tall figure, and is very good-looking. When he wears glasses, he has a gentle and elegant temperament, giving people the feeling that even a scumbag will pounce on him without hesitation.

Without glasses now, he looks even more cold and dignified.
